info.title: rsna-knee-labels-soft-v2
info.subtitle: Gold-calibrated soft targets from LLM severity states, RSNA Knee 202
info.description:
# RSNA Knee: severity-calibrated soft training targets (v2)

One row per training study (4,407). Built for warm-start fine-tuning of the public R6
ConvNeXt-small image models with `compact_train.py` (arm `E_prior`, BCE on `<Finding>|prior`).

## How the targets were made
1. **Severity states.** Each of the 4,349 report-only studies was labeled by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
   (run offline inside Kaggle, report text never left the machine) into one ordinal state per
   finding, e.g. Effusion: `not_mentioned / none / trace_or_small / moderate / large`;
   ACL: `not_mentioned / normal / signal_or_degeneration / low_grade_partial /
   high_grade_or_complete_tear / graft_or_postop`. Explicit negation and silence are kept distinct.
2. **Calibration on the 58 expert-labeled studies.** For each (finding, state) the empirical
   positive rate under the official grading was shrunk toward a tier prior (4 pseudo-observations)
   and made monotonic along the explicit severity ladder; `not_mentioned` is calibrated on its own.
   Hedged mentions are pulled 30% toward the finding's base rate.
3. Result: on the gold set the calibrated states reach macro AUC 0.831 vs 0.764 for a
   binary report label (states margin +0.066). Key example: ACL `signal_or_degeneration` is
   officially positive 8/21 while `high_grade_or_complete_tear` is 15/16.

## Columns
- `StudyInstanceUID`, `is_gold` (1 for the 58 expert-labeled studies), `review_holdout` (0), `fold` (0)
- per finding `
info.userSpecifiedSources: Report text from the RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection 2026 training set; expert labels for the 58 fully labeled training studies from the same source.
